head: Tuch sparks a Capitals comeback
paras: Jack Quinn and Josh Doan scored just over four minutes apart early in the first to put the Sabres up 2-0. Alex Tuch got the Capitals on the board late in the period, in his first game against Buffalo since leaving. Dylan Strome tied it 2-2 early in the second, and he struck again late in the period to put the Caps ahead 3-2. Noah Östlund made it 3-3 for Buffalo early in the third. Tuch won it with his second goal of the night in overtime. Strome added an assist for a three-point night.

The Capitals owned the chances, outshooting the Sabres 34-21, and still had to sweat it out in overtime. The Sabres hit a post and the crossbar and still lost. Charlie Lindgren made 18 saves for the Capitals, and Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen stopped 30 of 34. The Capitals improved to 6-4-0, climbing to fourth in the Metropolitan. The Sabres fell to 4-4-3, still last in the Atlantic.

items.text: The Sabres are winless in three (0-1-2).
The Capitals’ Pierre-Luc Dubois was back in the lineup after missing five games.
